items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with external labs on embedded alignment assessments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與外部實驗室合作進行嵌入式對齊評估
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it is working with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce AI, and Goodfire AI on embedded assessments. These give outside experts deep access to internal models and systems to investigate alignment risks and test safeguards.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce AI 及 Goodfire AI 合作進行嵌入式評估，讓外部專家深入存取內部模型與系統，以調查對齊風險並測試防護措施。
items_flat.analysis_en: This continues a shift toward independent scrutiny of frontier systems after earlier incidents. It remains unclear how broad the access will be or whether findings will be public.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這延續了在先前事件後轉向獨立審查前沿系統的趨勢。存取範圍有多廣、發現是否會公開，仍不明確。
items_flat.quote: We’re working with @ApolloResearch, @METR_Evals, @TransluceAI, and @GoodfireAI on embedded assessments: giving outside experts deep access to our internal models and systems to investigate alignment and test our safeguards.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正與 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce AI 及 Goodfire AI 合作進行嵌入式評估：讓外部專家深入存取我們的內部模型與系統，以調查對齊並測試防護措施。

items_flat.title_en: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max flagship with 1M context
items_flat.title_zh: 阿里巴巴發布 Qwen4-Max 旗艦模型，支援 100 萬上下文
items_flat.summary_en: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, the first model in its Qwen4 series. It is a 2.4-trillion-parameter sparse MoE with 71 billion active parameters per token, native vision, a 1-million-token context window, and lower API pricing than the prior Max model.
items_flat.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴發布 Qwen4 系列首個模型 Qwen4-Max。這是 2.4 兆參數稀疏 MoE 模型，每 token 啟用 710 億參數，具備原生視覺、100 萬 token 上下文視窗，且 API 價格低於前代 Max 模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens Chinese frontier closed models with efficiency claims and multimodal support. Open-weight smaller Qwen4 variants are promised but not yet available.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布強化中國閉源前沿模型的效率主張與多模態支援。較小的開源權重 Qwen4 變體已承諾但尚未推出。
items_flat.quote: Meet Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery!
items_flat.quote_zh: 認識 Qwen4-Max，你在工作、創意與探索中的新 AI 隊友！

items_flat.title_en: Google expands free Gemini 4 Carbon access for 10,000 scientists
items_flat.title_zh: Google 擴大 1 萬名科學家免費使用 Gemini 4 Carbon
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind expanded its Antigravity program for 10,000 scientists to include free access to Gemini 4 Carbon. Researchers are already using the model in multi-agent setups for formal verification, protein sequence discovery, and lab data analysis.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 擴大其針對 1 萬名科學家的 Antigravity 計畫，納入免費使用 Gemini 4 Carbon。研究人員已在多智能體設定中用該模型進行形式驗證、蛋白質序列發現與實驗室數據分析。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending free high-tier access to the newest frontier model could accelerate scientific use cases, but selection criteria and actual compute quotas for participants remain limited details.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將免費高階存取擴展至最新前沿模型，可能加速科學應用，但參與者的篩選標準與實際算力配額細節仍有限。
items_flat.quote: We’re expanding our Google @Antigravity program for 10,000 scientists to include free access to Gemini 4 Carbon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正擴大 Google Antigravity 計畫，讓 1 萬名科學家免費使用 Gemini 4 Carbon。

links.label: Google Blog: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
